scope: addendum to V41_UNLABELED_MS1_RISK_20261105.json: restrict the risk to the ACTUAL v4.1 training inputs (image<->label 1:1), not the pool frame count; read-only projection, no images/inference

method.estimate_is: upper bound of projected visibility (occlusion would reduce)

consequences_if_v41_labels_reused_as_is: 31 empty-negative frames (7.1% of actual inputs) would train class1 as pure background on MS1 views
38 positive frames (8.7% of actual inputs) would omit the MS1 instance while the tower bbox is supervised: the exact same-frame disambiguation case the pilot gate needs is taught as 'MS1 absent'
combined: 69/436 = 15.8% of actual v4.1 training inputs carry an unlabelled visible MS1; class1 recall and same-frame selection are the most exposed metrics
the 15.8% is a projected-visibility upper bound; occlusion/annotation conventions could reduce or increase it

mitigation_options.option: A. pre-register exclusion of affected frames
mitigation_options.rule: exclude v4.1 frames with projected MS1 height >= 8 px (or 20 px) from the two-class train pass; report the excluded fraction before training
mitigation_options.benefit: no contradictory class1 supervision; stays inside the pre-registered budget

mitigation_options.option: B. annotate class1 in affected frames
mitigation_options.rule: add the missing class1 instances (same-frame completeness) for the 69 frames; keeps the same-frame views
mitigation_options.cost: 69 frames of class1 annotation (plus QA); highest value is the 38 same-frame frames
mitigation_options.benefit: turns the risk into supervision for the exact gate case

mitigation_options.rule: try to ignore the MS1 region
mitigation_options.cost: ultralytics 8.2.0 pose loss has no per-region ignore; code change with new risk

recommendation: pre-register option A or B before any two-class training; do not silently reuse single-class v4.1 labels with visible MS1. If budget allows, B on the 38 same-frame frames is the most gate-relevant; A remains the conservative fallback. Re-run this projection check on the v6 label document and fail the label gate if any affected frame lacks class1 or an explicit exclusion.
limitations: v6 two-class labels do not exist yet (T30 capture in progress)
risk applies only if v4.1 single-class labels are reused; a full two-class v6 annotation of v4.1 would remove it
